lines.speaker: Endo
lines.text: There are shelters past the old iron bleedway. Stay close. The walls remember the safer line.
lines.context: Endo joins Aster and Peris outside the facility.

lines.speaker: Endo
lines.text: Iron ahead. Green beacons take the long way. The center is faster, but it takes flesh for toll.
lines.context: The party reaches the first safe-versus-direct route choice.

lines.speaker: Endo
lines.text: Light is going. The next sump holds its heat after dark. Choose the line before you cross.
lines.context: Dusk closes in between the first and second iron sectors.

lines.speaker: Endo
lines.text: There. Seal first, breathe second. Nothing outside gets to choose our pace.

lines.speaker: Endo
lines.text: Sleep in shifts if you can. The wall will hold until dawn. I will listen for what follows.
lines.context: The party takes its first shelter rest.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: At dawn, rust-light finds three sets of tracks leaving Shelter 1.
lines.context: Morning after the party's first shelter rest.
